_comment: HTU / Undulator channel limits. Generated by build-profile/tools/generate_channel_limits.py from the GEECS DB snapshot (same extract as the channel database) — do not hand-edit; rerun the generator. Writable surface: exactly the :SP setpoint PVs of settable GEECS variables, plus the gateway restart PV. min/max mirror the GEECS DB limits (also enforced gateway-side as EPICS control limits); entries without min/max are settable variables the GEECS DB does not bound — the device remains the authority.
